with events as (

    from "c360"."c360_staging"."stg_ga4__events"
    where ga_session_id is not null
),

first_event as (
    select session_key, device_category, country, first_user_source, first_user_medium, first_user_campaign
    from events
    where true
    qualify row_number() over (partition by session_key order by event_ts, event_name) = 1
),

session_traffic as (
    select session_key, param_source, param_medium, param_campaign
    from events
    where param_source is not null
    qualify row_number() over (partition by session_key order by event_ts, event_name) = 1
),

landing as (
    select session_key, page_location as landing_page
    from events
    where event_name = 'page_view'
    qualify row_number() over (partition by session_key order by event_ts, event_name) = 1
),

purchases as (
    select session_key, count(*) as purchases, sum(purchase_revenue) as session_revenue
    from "c360"."c360_staging"."stg_ga4__purchases"
    group by session_key
),

agg as (
    select
        session_key,
        min(user_pseudo_id)                                                     as device_id,
        min(event_ts)                                                           as session_start_ts,
        max(event_ts)                                                           as session_end_ts,
        count(*)                                                                as event_count,
        sum(case when event_name = 'page_view' then 1 else 0 end)               as page_views,
        sum(case when event_name = 'view_item' then 1 else 0 end)               as item_views,
        max(case when event_name = 'add_to_cart' then 1 else 0 end)             as has_add_to_cart,
        max(case when event_name = 'begin_checkout' then 1 else 0 end)          as has_checkout,
        max(user_id)                                                            as user_id_in_session
    from events
    group by session_key
),

resolved as (
    select
        a.*,
        f.device_category,
        f.country,
        l.landing_page,
        coalesce(p.purchases, 0)                                                as purchases,
        coalesce(p.session_revenue, 0)                                          as session_revenue,
        case when t.param_source is not null then t.param_source
             else coalesce(f.first_user_source, '(direct)') end                 as utm_source,
        case when t.param_source is not null then coalesce(t.param_medium, '(not set)')
             else coalesce(f.first_user_medium, '(none)') end                   as utm_medium,
        case when t.param_source is not null then coalesce(t.param_campaign, '(not set)')
             else coalesce(f.first_user_campaign, '(direct)') end               as utm_campaign
    from agg a
    left join first_event f on f.session_key = a.session_key
    left join session_traffic t on t.session_key = a.session_key
    left join landing l on l.session_key = a.session_key
    left join purchases p on p.session_key = a.session_key
)

with tracks as (

gaps as (
    select
        *,
        lag(event_ts) over (partition by anonymous_id order by event_ts, message_id) as prev_ts
    from tracks
),

flagged as (
    select
        *,
        case when prev_ts is null
               or (cast(floor(epoch(event_ts)) as bigint) - cast(floor(epoch(prev_ts)) as bigint)) > 30 * 60
             then 1 else 0 end as is_new_session
    from gaps
),

numbered as (
    select
        *,
        sum(is_new_session) over (partition by anonymous_id order by event_ts, message_id
                                  rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as session_number
    from flagged
),

keyed as (
    select *, min(event_ts) over (partition by anonymous_id, session_number) as session_start_ts
    from numbered
),

with_key as (

with crm as (
    select * from "c360"."c360_staging"."stg_crm__orders"
),

crm_person as (
    select node_value as crm_customer_id, person_id
    from "c360"."c360_ml"."identity_nodes"
    where node_type = 'crm'
),

ga4 as (
    select transaction_id, session_key, purchase_revenue from "c360"."c360_staging"."stg_ga4__purchases"
),

seg as (
    select o.order_id as external_ref, o.revenue as tracker_revenue, s.session_key
    from "c360"."c360_staging"."stg_segment__orders" o
    left join "c360"."c360_intermediate"."int_segment__sessions" s
        on s.device_id = o.anonymous_id
       and o.event_ts between s.session_start_ts and s.session_end_ts
    where true
    qualify row_number() over (partition by o.order_id order by s.session_start_ts) = 1
),

joined as (
    select
        c.order_id,
        coalesce(p.person_id, concat('crm:', c.customer_id))                  as person_id,
        c.customer_id                                                          as crm_customer_id,
        c.ordered_at,
        c.order_date,
        c.order_channel,
        c.status,
        c.gross_amount,
        c.discount_amount,
        c.paid_amount,
        c.refund_amount,
        c.net_revenue,
        c.external_ref,
        coalesce(g.session_key, sg.session_key)                                as converting_session_key,
        (g.transaction_id is not null or sg.external_ref is not null)         as is_tracked_online,
        case when c.order_channel = 'web' then g.purchase_revenue else sg.tracker_revenue end as tracker_revenue,
        (c.status = 'completed')                                               as is_conversion,
        (c.order_date >= cast('2020-11-01' as date))              as in_tracking_window
    from crm c
    left join crm_person p on p.crm_customer_id = c.customer_id
    left join ga4 g on c.order_channel = 'web' and g.transaction_id = c.external_ref
    left join seg sg on c.order_channel = 'app' and sg.external_ref = c.external_ref
),

completed as (
    select
        order_id,
        row_number() over (partition by person_id order by ordered_at, order_id)        as customer_order_number,
        lag(order_date) over (partition by person_id order by ordered_at, order_id)     as prev_order_date
    from joined
    where is_conversion
)

select
    j.*,
    c.customer_order_number,
    coalesce(c.customer_order_number = 1, false)                                       as is_first_order,
    case when c.prev_order_date is not null
         then date_diff('day', c.prev_order_date, j.order_date) end       as days_since_prev_order,
    case when j.tracker_revenue is not null then abs(j.paid_amount - j.tracker_revenue) end as revenue_gap_vs_tracker
from joined j
left join completed c on c.order_id = j.order_id

with sessions as (

nodes as (

),

joined as (
    select
        s.*,
        n.person_id                                       as linked_person_id,
        coalesce(n.is_shared_device, false)               as is_shared_device
    from sessions s
    left join nodes n
        on n.node_key = concat(case when s.source_system = 'ga4' then 'ga:' else 'sa:' end, s.device_id)

final as (

        coalesce(linked_person_id, concat('anon:', device_id)) as resolved_person_id
    from joined

        min(session_start_ts)                                                       as first_session_at,
        max(session_start_ts)                                                       as last_session_at,
        max(case when is_shared_device then 1 else 0 end)                           as uses_shared_device
    from "c360"."c360_marts"."fct_sessions"
    where is_identified
    group by person_id
),

first_sess as (
    select person_id, channel_group as first_session_channel, campaign_key as first_session_campaign_key
    from "c360"."c360_marts"."fct_sessions"
    where is_identified
    qualify row_number() over (partition by person_id order by session_start_ts, session_key) = 1
),

base as (
    select
        c.person_id,
        c.customer_id                                                               as primary_crm_customer_id,
        c.crm_record_count,
        c.email_hash,
        c.first_name,
        c.country_code,
        c.city,
        c.created_at                                                                as signup_at,
        c.marketing_opt_in,
        c.loyalty_tier,
        c.self_reported_source,
        c.signup_channel,
        coalesce(s.total_sessions, 0)                                               as total_sessions,
        coalesce(s.web_sessions, 0)                                                 as web_sessions,
        coalesce(s.app_sessions, 0)                                                 as app_sessions,
        coalesce(s.distinct_devices, 0)                                             as distinct_devices,
        s.first_session_at,
        s.last_session_at,
        (coalesce(s.app_sessions, 0) > 0)                                           as is_app_user,
        (coalesce(s.distinct_devices, 0) > 1)                                       as is_multi_device,
        (coalesce(s.uses_shared_device, 0) = 1)                                     as uses_shared_device,
        coalesce(o.order_count, 0)                                                  as order_count,
        coalesce(o.return_count, 0)                                                 as return_count,
        coalesce(o.net_revenue, 0)                                                  as historical_clv_revenue,
        coalesce(o.net_revenue, 0) * 0.45                  as historical_clv_profit,
        o.avg_order_value,
        o.first_order_at,
        o.last_order_at,
        coalesce(o.web_orders, 0)                                                   as web_orders,
        coalesce(o.app_orders, 0)                                                   as app_orders,
        coalesce(o.store_orders, 0)                                                 as store_orders,
        case when o.last_order_at is not null
             then date_diff('day', cast(o.last_order_at as date), cast('2021-01-31' as date)) end   as recency_days,
        case when o.first_order_at is not null
             then date_diff('day', cast(o.first_order_at as date), cast('2021-01-31' as date)) end  as days_since_first_order,
        case
            when o.first_order_at is null then 'Unknown'
            when cast(o.first_order_at as date) < cast('2020-11-01' as date) then 'Pre-tracking (existing customer)'
            else coalesce(fs.first_session_channel, 'Untracked (no linked session)')
        end                                                                         as acquisition_channel,
        fs.first_session_campaign_key,
        r.r_score,
        r.f_score,
        r.m_score,
        r.rfm_code,
        r.rfm_segment,
        r.monetary_tier,
        f.p_alive,
        f.predicted_orders_12m,
        f.predicted_aov,
        coalesce(f.clv_12m_revenue, 0)                                              as predicted_clv_12m_revenue,
        coalesce(f.clv_12m_revenue, 0) * 0.45              as predicted_clv_12m_profit
    from primary_crm c
    left join sess s on s.person_id = c.person_id
    left join first_sess fs on fs.person_id = c.person_id
    left join "c360"."c360_intermediate"."int_customer__orders" o on o.person_id = c.person_id
    left join "c360"."c360_marts"."customer_rfm" r on r.person_id = c.person_id
    left join "c360"."c360_ml"."clv_forecast" f on f.person_id = c.person_id
),

scored as (
    select
        *,
        historical_clv_revenue + predicted_clv_12m_revenue                          as total_clv_revenue,
        case when order_count > 0
             then percent_rank() over (partition by (case when order_count > 0 then 1 else 0 end)
                                       order by historical_clv_revenue + predicted_clv_12m_revenue) end as clv_percentile
    from base
)

select
    *,
    case
        when clv_percentile is null then 'No orders'
        when clv_percentile >= 0.95 then 'Platinum'
        when clv_percentile >= 0.80 then 'Gold'
        when clv_percentile >= 0.50 then 'Silver'
        else 'Bronze'
    end                                                                             as clv_tier,
    case
        when order_count = 0 then 'Prospect'
        when days_since_first_order <= 30 then 'New'
        when recency_days <= 90 and coalesce(p_alive, 1) >= 0.5 then 'Active'
        when recency_days <= 180 and coalesce(p_alive, 1) >= 0.25 then 'At Risk'
        else 'Churned'
    end                                                                             as lifecycle_stage
from scored

    from "c360"."c360_marts"."fct_attribution_credits" c
    left join "c360"."c360_marts"."customer_profile" p on p.person_id = c.person_id
    group by c.model, c.campaign_key
),

keys as (

    ) k
),

models as (

joined as (
    select
        k.campaign_key,
        m.model,
        coalesce(s.channel_group, cr.channel_group)          as channel_group,
        s.platform,
        s.campaign_name,

        coalesce(cr.new_customer_clv_credit, 0)              as new_customer_clv_credit
    from keys k

)
